Oneliner

Deploy and rigidize a 1 meter long inflatable UV cured boom.
Description

Deploy and rigidize a 1 meter long inflatable UV cured boom from a 1U CubeSat platform in low Earth orbit. Measure attitude behavior of GASPACS to observe the effectiveness of the deployed boom assisting in a passive attitude control system.
Results

GASPACS has now been in space for a month! A summary of the mission so far:

  • Deployed from the International Space Station on January 26.
  • Played The Scotsman all over the world.
  • Confirmed AeroBoom deployment, completing the primary mission objective in less than 24 hours .
  • Lost two solar panels due to a space weather event on January 29. We believe that the event disrupted the MPPT EPS system, which cannot reset according to the manufacturer.
  • Took and transmitted seven incredible pictures from space.
  • Confirmed passive stabilization from the AeroBoom, completing the secondary mission objective.

The GASPACS mission lasted 117 days between deployment on January 26, 2022, and reentry on May 23, 2022. Despite facing numerous challenges and roadblocks along the way, GASPACS completed all its mission objectives and was widely acknowledged a great success.
